_comment: Hand-maintained model metrics, used only when no Artificial Analysis API key is set (source 'manual'). Keys: "agent:modelId" or "modelId". Fields: intelligence_index, coding_index, agentic_index, benchmarks {terminalbench_hard, scicode, ...}, tokens_per_s, ttft_s, context_window, pricing {input, output} (USD per 1M tokens). Only enter numbers you have a source for.
